title: sighash-prevout-binding: Taproot-native input binding with OP_CAT and OP_CHECKSIGFROMSTACK on Bitcoin Inquisition signet
description: A tapscript leaf that makes UTXO A spendable only if a specific UTXO B is spent in the same transaction, by binding to the BIP-341 sha_prevouts field through same-signature binding and preimage decomposition with OP_CAT (BIP 347) and OP_CHECKSIGFROMSTACK (BIP 348). Includes the construction code and a keyless verifier for the confirmed signet transactions.
